messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Amoxicillin is a penicillin antibiotic.
Amoxicillin is used to treat bacterial infections.
The infections include tonsillitis, bronchitis, sinusitis, pneumonia, and infections of the ear, nose, throat, skin, or urinary tract.
Amoxicillin clavulanate is a combination of amoxicillin and clavulanate potassium.
The amoxicillin fights bacteria.
The clavulanate potassium helps prevent certain bacteria from becoming resistant to amoxicillin.
Amoxicillin is sometimes used together with another antibiotic called clarithromycin (Biaxin).
This combination is used to treat stomach ulcers.
The ulcers are caused by Helicobacter pylori infection.
This combination is sometimes used with a stomach acid reducer called lansoprazole (Prevacid).
Amoxicillin 500mg and 250mg are available as tablets or capsules and as an oral suspension.
Many brands and forms of amoxicillin are available.
Not all brands are listed on this leaflet.

The relation 'caused by' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject condition is caused by the pathogen or factor specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

B. 'can lead to': The subject condition or event may result in the medical complication or outcome specified by the object entity.
C. 'is defined as': The subject condition or entity is defined by the description specified by the object entity.
D. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
E. 'may be used for': The subject drug may be used for the purpose or condition specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.
